description:
• Brand introduction: 4Joy Paddles is dedicated to bringing lightheartedness and positivity to the court through our premium quality playfulI colorful Pickleball Paddle line. Our company mission is to give back by donating a portion of our revenue to charitable organizations that support  health.

At 4Joy, we believe in playing with purpose. Founded by a brain tumor survivor and mom of two, our company is rooted in resilience, creativity, and joy—values that are infused into every paddle we craft. Our Premio Series is not just a top-tier thermoformed paddle built with elite T-700 raw carbon fiber—it’s a statement piece for players who want to stand out and inspire.

As an affiliate, you’re not just promoting a high-performance product—you’re aligning with a brand that champions individuality, boldness, and purpose-driven living. Whether you're an athlete, influencer, coach, or community leader, 4Joy strengthens your personal brand by connecting you with a story and a mission your audience will feel good supporting.

Join us in bringing more joy, power, and purpose to the court—and to your platform.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): You’re not here to blend in—you’re here to break boundaries. 4Joy Paddles are crafted for those who play with power and live with purpose.
• Payment terms: 

Affiliate commissions are paid on a monthly basis, typically by the 15th of each month, for all approved commissions earned in the previous month.

Commission Approval Window:
All commissions are subject to a 14-day holding period to allow for order processing, returns, or cancellations. Commissions may be adjusted or voided if an order is refunded or disputed.

Payment Methods:
We offer affiliate payouts via:

  • PayPal 

  • Bank transfer
